europe_now.title: Germany Reduces Energy Taxes
europe_now.summary: Germany has implemented cuts to energy taxes to alleviate soaring petrol prices driven by international market pressures. The fiscal adjustment aims to ease cost-of-living burdens on consumers.

sources.headline: Germany cuts fuel tax as Middle East conflicts send prices soaring
Germany cuts energy tax to lower soaring petrol prices

europe_now.title: Poland Credit Rating Downgraded
europe_now.summary: Moody's has lowered Poland's credit rating to its lowest level recorded since 2002. The downgrade reflects growing economic and fiscal concerns within the country.

sources.headline: Moody’s cuts Poland’s credit rating to lowest level since 2002

top_stories.title: US and Denmark Greenland Agreement
top_stories.summary: The United States and Denmark have reached a new bilateral agreement concerning defense and investment in Greenland. Officials highlighted the strategic importance of the evolving transatlantic arrangement.

sources.headline: US and Denmark reach deal on Greenland, Trump claims 'permanent control' over island
US and Denmark reach new agreement on defense and investment in Greenland

top_stories.title: French Security Warnings and Hybrid Threats
top_stories.summary: French leadership has issued public warnings regarding heightened risks of Russian hybrid attacks targeting national infrastructure. Authorities are actively working to strengthen domestic energy defense capabilities.
